description: Checked by reading each L7 consumer section (A01–A04, M04): the log table exists and its last row's dev-pin string is identical to the pin named in the Supported peer-SDK range bullet. A log lagging its range means the pin has two homes again, which is the drift this field exists to prevent.
text: Every L7 consumer section contains a Verified-pin log whose newest row names the same dev-pin as its Supported peer-SDK range.
title: Every L7 consumer section contains a Verified-pin log whose newest row names the same dev-pin as its Supported peer-SDK range.
